This method returns all objects which are in some relation to the object specified in URL.

query.description: Specifies the relation which should be returned, see [relations](https://github.com/phaidra/phaidra-api/wiki/Relations)

searches for the relation in opposite direction (e.g. for `hasCollectionMember`: 0 will return a list of objects which are members of this object/collection, 1 will return a list of objects/collections where the object is a member)
fields from the index which should be returned. Only works for `fields=dc.description`. The title field is returned by default. Preferred title and description fields are the English ones.
